Scope.title: Export scope parameters
Scope.description: Selects enterprises or chains for which the data should be exported. Which one is used depends on `EntityType`. If not specified, the export will include all enterprises or chains the client has access to.

Filters.title: Export data filters
Filters.description: Specifies filters to apply on the exported data set. If omitted, the export will include all available data.
